title: On World Cancer Day, Rep. Sewell Celebrates Signing of the Nancy Gardner Sewell Multi-Cancer Early Detection Act
key_claim: Nancy Gardner Sewell Medicare MCED Screening Coverage Act signed into law 03/02/2026; bill included in FY2026 appropriations package; was most co-sponsored bill in 119th Congress (339 House, 68 Senate); creates CMS authority to cover blood-based MCED tests once FDA-approved with demonstrated clinical benefit.
notes: Primary regulatory source - the enacting authority for the coverage pivot.

title: H.R. 842 - Nancy Gardner Sewell Medicare Multi-Cancer Early Detection Screening Coverage Act (119th Congress, 2025-2026)
key_claim: Statutory text authorizes Medicare to treat MCED tests as a covered screening benefit once FDA-approved and shown to demonstrate clinical benefit; coverage authority effective 2028.

title: Clinical implementation of multi-cancer early detection tests: can we find a path forward?
key_claim: Sewell Act enacted 03/02/2026 enables Medicare MCED coverage despite no FDA approval of any MCED test and no evidence that population screening with MCED reduces cancer-related or all-cause mortality; raises payer and policymaker questions about coverage-evidence alignment.
notes: Peer-reviewed analysis explicitly framing the coverage-evidence gap.

title: Grail stock craters as key NHS-Galleri cancer blood test trial fails to hit primary endpoint
key_claim: NHS-Galleri trial in 142,000 NHS participants aged 50-77 over three years missed primary endpoint of statistically significant Stage III-IV cancer reduction; Grail stock fell sharply (-51% per Trefis) after Feb 19 announcement.
notes: Industry trade press on the central negative-evidence finding.

title: NHS-Galleri MCD trial fails to meet primary endpoint of stage shift
key_claim: Detailed clinical-trial reporting confirms primary endpoint miss; favorable pre-specified trend in 12 deadly cancers; Grail to extend follow-up 6-12 months; detailed data to be presented at ASCO 2026.
notes: Oncology trade press with detailed trial readout.

title: Bipartisan Support Secures MCED Coverage in Medicare
key_claim: Sewell Act provides CMS authority to cover blood-based MCED tests starting 2028 once FDA-approved with clinical benefit; bipartisan vote 341 to 88 in House; sets pathway-without-evidence policy precedent.
notes: Managed-care trade press framing the coverage pivot from payer perspective.

publisher: Journal of the National Cancer Institute (Oxford Academic)
title: National Health Service-Galleri multicancer screening trial: explanation and justification of unique and important design issues
key_claim: Peer-reviewed methodological discussion of NHS-Galleri trial design issues; ASCO 2026 presentation expected with detailed efficacy and stage-shift data; trial designed to inform NHS commissioning decision.
notes: Peer-reviewed framing of the NHS-Galleri trial design for commissioning.

title: GRAIL Submits FDA Premarket Approval Application for the Galleri Multi-Cancer Early Detection Test
key_claim: Grail submitted final module of PMA application to FDA for Galleri 29/01/2026; positions Galleri to be the first FDA-approved MCED test.
